step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to determine if the client has authorization to work in Canada.
Determine if the client was reached during fact-finding:

ul.li: If no, go to Creating a WI for Level 2 . Creating a WI for Level 2

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Authorization to work in Canada — 900-series SIN.”

Details: Type “Client was contacted to request proof of authorization to work in Canada. Client states [client’s statement].” Document the fact-finding details according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Determine if the client intends to provide a copy of an open work permit or proof of interim work authorization in Canada (and all supporting documents):

ul.li: If no, go to Creating a WI for Level 2 . Creating a WI for Level 2

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li:
Comments: Type the appropriate option:
“Verify that the client has submitted a new valid open work permit.”
“Verify that the client has submitted proof of interim work authorization in Canada and all supporting documents.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.
